code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation and pO₂), metabolic acidosis (low arterial pH), mild leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and relative monocytosis, eosinophilia, and basophilia. Mildly elevated urea may indicate prerenal azotemia or dehydration. Hemoglobin and red cell indices are within normal limits. Findings suggest possible respiratory failure with hypoxemia and acidosis, and bone marrow suppression or infection; urgent clinical evaluation is recommended.
